description: A vulnerability was determined in SonicJs-Org SonicJS up to 3.0.1. This impacts the function AuthManager.verifyToken of the file packages/core/src/middleware/auth.ts. Executing a manipulation can lead to use of hard-coded cryptographic key . It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. A patch should be applied to remediate this issue. Vendor confirmed remediation by adding a bootstrap.ts security check that logs a warning in development and throws a hard error in production when JWT_SECRET is missing or still the default value.
